_notes.method: Measured with scripts/analyze_boundary.py on opaque splats (A>100/120) in world metres. 'maps' = wide top-down colour/height maps (outputs/parts/boundary/td_*.png, half 12 m, 40 px/m); 'wmap <cam>' = reference images annotated with the world XYZ of the nearest splat on a 64 px grid (outputs/parts/boundary/wmap_*.png) used to identify which boundary object each camera sees; 'profile' = height (z95) / colour statistics in 12 bins along a segment; face positions = density peak of splats with 1.3<z<3.2 per 0.5-1 m bin (garden-side face of walls, ivy and hedges).
_notes.frame: Polyline points are [x, y, top_z]; curves lie on z=0 (paving/lawn level; boundary ground measured 0.0 +-0.1). 'offset' is lateral shift of the slab centre, + = left of travel (direction of the point list).
_notes.house_west: Yellow London-stock brick facade seen at the top of the right_960 view. Face line from density peaks: x = -5.35 @ y=-4.5 ... -7.95 @ y=3.5 (+-0.1 m); continues north behind the hedge to y~7.3 (x~-8.0, z up to 4.2). Scan only records it up to z~3.0-3.6 (frame top), the real house is taller: 6 m used (above every reference frame). Red brick spans (window heads / bands) visible at z~0.95-1.3 in right_960; their period along the wall is a visual estimate.
_notes.shed: Red-brick outbuilding with black door seen in low_side/left. Front face from density peaks x=4.35@y=5.0, 4.75@4.0, 4.95@2.0, 5.05@1.5. Eave height z95 2.1-2.25 along t<0.25 (profile 4.4,5.0 -> 5.5,1.0). Door centre at t~0.19 along the front (world ~4.52,4.45), width ~0.8 m, top ~1.9 m from low_side annotated grid. Depth/back height are NOT observed (no camera sees behind): 2.2 m deep, mono-pitch roof up to 2.9 m assumed.
_notes.fence: Dark stained featheredge fence between the north hedge and the gate: brown splats (r>g>=b) 0.6<z<2.4 form a line x 2.45->2.95, y 6.25->4.6; top z95 1.74-1.80 (+-0.03). Gate (lighter, olive-grey slats): line (3.0,4.5)->(4.3,4.95), slat top 1.72, posts/arch to z95 2.1-2.18.
_notes.hedges: North hedge face (south side) y = 3.55@x=-7.5, 4.25@-5.5, 4.75@-3.5, 5.35@-1.5, 5.85@0.5, 6.25@1.5, 6.95@3.0; centre line placed ~0.4 m behind the face; tops z95 2.45-2.65 (3.3-3.7 at the house corner). East climber/hedge on the boundary wall: face x = 5.05@y=1.5 ... 6.65@y=-3.5, tops 2.4-3.3. Ivy column in front of the shed (4.45-4.55, 2.9-3.4) up to z 3.4. Colours are sRGB scan medians: shade ~ (70,90,40), lit tops (150-185,165-200,95-120).
_notes.north_border: Low planting band in front of the north hedge, y 4.3-5.5, z 0.5-1.2, seen across the top of opposite_960 (shrubs agent excludes y>4.2). Sparse red/pink valerian flowers in low_side.
_notes.far: Far vegetation clusters: green splats r>7 m, z>1.8 in 2 m cells (centre, z5..z95): (13,21) 3.8-6.7, (15,21) 4-7, (17,21) 5.3-8.2, (19,21) 5.1-8.6, (11,15) 2.8-5.9, (9,19) 3.2-5.8, (13,11) 3.9-5.0, (3,7) 2.0-3.1 (tree just behind the gate). Far splat depth is poorly constrained (+-30 %), directions/elevations from the cameras are what matter. Neighbour building behind the shed: pale/brick splats (9-11, 2.5-5.5) z 3.2-4.6.

Raised timber deck x 2.65-4.5, y -7.5..-8.3, deck z ~0.85 (z-histogram break), slatted balustrade along the back to z ~1.45 (splats z 1.2-1.5 at y -8.0..-8.75). _notes.trunks: Thin pale trunk in front of the fence (low_side x~345 px): splats (2.0-2.1, 5.3-5.5) from z 0.4 to the frame top (>2.6); diameter ~0.15 m from its pixel width at 7.5 m. Top height unobserved (4.5 m assumed).
_notes.boxes: Facade doorway: dark splats on the facade at y 2.4-3.2 (right_960 x 800-880 px, projected), height to frame top (>1.3), 2.2 m assumed. Not built by STRUCTURES (only chairs/slide/toys). Downpipe: black vertical in right_960 at x~580 px -> facade at y~0.2 (x -6.98), 0.08 m.
